note: Room configuration foundation for the Kitten Nest world. This file documents current active coffeeCorner ports, protected objects, coordinate anchors, and director cards for future room/runtime work. It is not a full roomEngine runtime yet.

currentRuntime.stableWorkflow: Alex update package -> /write -> generate drafts -> publish all -> /cloud. The powder notebook can also be edited directly inside /cloud. Setup/local upload remains manually available.

identityPolicy.ownershipRule: Every active selector has one primary owner. exclusive:true means no casual selector reuse.
identityPolicy.versionRule: canonicalCurrent means current official truth, not permanent immutability. Current objects may change later through mutableWithVersion.
identityPolicy.coordinateRule: Coordinates should be locked to base-image coordinates, not device-specific offsets.
identityPolicy.documentationRule: Prefer framework rules and identity cards over long incident diaries.

coffeeCorner.lineRule: Each non-empty line becomes one rotating bubble. If there is only one bubble, the 19.8 hotspot still re-shows it after hiding.

windowWeather.lineRule: Line 1 becomes windowTemp. Line 2 becomes windowDesc.

hubbyNote.lineRule: The whole block becomes the current hubbyNote page. Older current pages are appended to hubbyNoteArchive.

rooms.label: 咖啡角
rooms.vibe: Warm, soft, domestic coffee corner. A place for morning greetings, small notes, weather-by-the-window, sleepy affection, tiny daily discoveries, and Nest stability checks.
rooms.sceneNotes: Current real front-stage room. This room owns the coffeeCorner bubble queue, window weather text/advice, active 19.8 coordinate hotspot, active game console hotspot, setup/local upload access, and active powder notebook entry/editor.

textPorts.description: Main rotating speech bubble in the coffee corner. Bubble tap hides it; 19.8 tap shows or advances it.

directorCard.futureUse: Can receive lines selected by room, hotspot, weather, time, or mood later. Current runtime still uses the published coffeeCorner queue.

textPorts.description: Small weather text near the window.

directorCard.futureUse: Feeds the active weather advice hotspot without replacing the main coffeeCorner bubble queue.

textPorts.description: Cloud-backed powder notebook. It can be written from /write using [hubbyNote] or edited directly inside /cloud.

directorCard.currentUse: Current page is stored in hubbyNote. Previous pages are stored permanently in hubbyNoteArchive. Deletions go to hubbyNoteTrash.
directorCard.futureUse: When dedicated notebook art exists, only the entry/hotspot and layout should change; save/archive/favorite/delete logic should remain owned by hubby-note-controller.

hotspots.label: 19.8 tattoo hotspot
hotspots.intent: Toggle or advance the coffeeCorner bubble. If the bubble queue has only one item, re-show that single bubble after hiding. Must stay responsive and should not be mixed with weather logic.

directorCard.futureUse: Can choose or filter bubble lines by hotspot mood later. Currently the runtime uses the normal coffeeCorner bubble queue.

hotspots.label: window weather advice hotspot
hotspots.intent: Clickable weather area. When tapped, it opens a lightweight glass-style hubby weather advice popup based on windowTemp and windowDesc.

directorCard.memoryHook: hubby weather advice by the coffee corner window
directorCard.futureUse: Can later use a dedicated illustrated weather panel or coordinate-locked custom art. Current implementation is a lightweight DOM popup.

hotspots.label: game console hotspot
hotspots.intent: Open the game menu. This selector belongs to the game console and should not be reused by unrelated notebook, weather, or room objects.

directorCard.futureUse: Can later be represented by dedicated console art or coordinate-locked selector, but ownership remains gameMenu unless explicitly versioned.

hotspots.label: powder notebook entry
hotspots.intent: Open the cloud-backed powder notebook panel. Current temporary entry is the left-bottom powder notebook button. Future dedicated notebook art can replace only this entry point.

currentBehavior.storedKeyUx: hide stored key after authorization; show authorized chip; reveal key input only when changing key

directorCard.futureUse: When Vicky creates dedicated notebook art, keep this data/control logic and only replace the visual entry/hotspot/layout.

hotspots.label: setup/materials button
hotspots.intent: Open the setup/materials panel manually while keeping the panel hidden by default.

directorCard.futureUse: May later be hidden behind a more polished settings icon, but manual setup access must remain available.

panels.label: powder notebook panel
panels.description: Temporary DOM notebook panel. Data/control logic is durable; visual layout and hotspot entry should wait for future dedicated notebook art.

directorCard.futureUse: Replace temporary layout with dedicated notebook art later without changing the cloud save/archive/favorite/delete pipeline.

panels.label: setup/materials panel
panels.description: Manual local image upload and material setup panel. It may be hidden by default, but manual access and local upload override must remain available.

assetPipelines.description: Local user-uploaded room images can override default cloud assets. Default static image fallback must not block this pipeline.

overlays.label: coffee corner speech bubble
overlays.description: Currently positioned by existing page/CSS behavior. Future work may lock this to a base-image coordinate after the coordinate system is generalized.

overlays.label: window weather text
overlays.description: Currently positioned by existing page/CSS behavior. It is now also the click target for the active weather advice popup.

future.notes: Future hotspots and overlays should be positioned by base-image coordinates rather than viewport/device-specific offsets. Do not add new API functions for this; use front-end assets and room config.

rooms.label: 主页 / home
rooms.vibe: Landing room and stable entrance. Used for day/night home mood, opening state, and future navigation.
rooms.sceneNotes: Currently exists as visual entry/background logic, not as a full text room.

architectureNotes.nextRefactorGoal: Make hotspot and overlay placement configuration-driven inside existing front-end assets without adding new API wrappers. Keep notebook data/control logic separate from future notebook art/layout.
architectureNotes.principle: Static assets, front-end controllers, and JSON config should carry future world expansion. Do not add more runtime API functions for rooms, image proxies, or hotspot wrappers.
